Topic.name: streetlights
Topic.description: Streetlights are lighting fixtures installed along streets and public areas to provide illumination for safety and visibility. They include various types such as wood pole, concrete pole, and private development streetlights on city right-of-way. Notable locations include Coral Gables, French Village on Hardee, northeastern apartment district, and along Calle Ocho and Bird Road. The city promotes the use of city-branded streetlights and maintains street jewelry as part of urban design and city branding efforts.

Topic.name: urban design
Topic.description: Urban design involves the aesthetic and functional planning of city spaces, including street furniture, lighting, and public monuments. It emphasizes the importance of city branding, historical preservation, and creating a welcoming environment as seen in the street jewelry and new monuments. Urban design aims to enhance the visual appeal and identity of the city, integrating elements like street poles, lighting, and public art.

Topic.name: branding
Topic.description: Branding in the city context refers to the promotion of city identity through visual elements such as street jewelry, monuments, and street lighting. It involves establishing a unique city image that reflects its history, culture, and community pride. The city encourages the use of its brand in public infrastructure and urban elements to foster a cohesive and recognizable cityscape.
